chat_messages.text: Birthday cake in the staff room – help yourselves.
Hi, my training certificate is renewed – where should I send the copy?
Can whoever is on late tomorrow bring the menu cards down to the kitchen?
Thanks – I'll check and come back to you.
New gloves size M are in the cupboard by the lift.
Is anyone driving past the pharmacy today?
Question for the boss: I'd need Saturday 3 October off, it's a family wedding. Would that be OK?
Sabine, yes, that's fine – approved. I haven't put it in the system, the rota will take care of it.
Lift on the first floor is working again.
Reminder: 12 of our registered nurses are on the mandatory training on Mon 14 Sep 2026 (09:00–16:30). The list is in the office mailbox.
Reminder: the new hoist slings are in the store room, old ones go back to the laundry.
Hi Uwe, could I have the 14th off next month? Happy to work the weekend before.
The GP round is moved to Thursday 11:00 this week.
Thanks – I'll check and come back to you.
Thanks for staying on last night!

Dear Uwe,

Please find attached the hours we processed for August 2026. For the next run we need any changes to contracted hours, new starters and leavers by Tue 22 Sep 2026. Hours above or below contract go to each person's hours account and are balanced with time off; overtime is paid out only when the home manager approves it.

If any of the figures look wrong, reply to this mail with the staff number and the corrected hours – please do not edit the file.

Kind regards
Elif Weber
Lohnbüro Sorantis

Marek Meyer
